versions.content: allowed key / value TagWithOptionalValue combinations The following key / value combinations are supported: • key present, with no value (e.g. "passreq" -> password required for this service) • key present, with empty value (e.g. "PlugIns=" -> server supports plugins, but none are presently installed) • key present, with non-empty value (e.g. "PlugIns=JPEG,MPEG2,MPEG4")
